_comment: Per-host policy + assignment. max_parallel is POLICY (installs allowed at once), independent of hardware max_concurrent_vms. Coordinator is the sole writer.

topology.note: Persistent services (mirror + dashboard) live on og128x01, the always-on Mac Pro. ugnomarchy is a laptop and must not be a hard dependency.
topology.worker_console_pattern: each worker publishes VNC_HOST=<host>.hydra-hammerhead.ts.net so the projector browser reaches its console

og128x01.hardware: Mac Pro Xeon, 128GB, 24c, 1TB NVMe, headless, always-on
og128x01.status: blocked: clone approval + docker + qemu/dmg2img + kvm group; wifi backup planned for flaky wired bridge; max_parallel raisable (huge capacity)

omarchiMac.status: ready pending deps; single-VM by user request

notes: AVX2 hosts (omarchiMac, ugnomarchy) are the ONLY ones that can run Ventura/Sonoma/Sequoia/Tahoe.
og128x01 (no AVX2) takes High Sierra..Monterey; its capacity makes it the parallel workhorse for those.
EULA acceptance is a human gate on every install unless the user authorizes agents to click Agree.
